# Pika - Omnichannel Marketing Automation Platform

> Pika is a comprehensive omnichannel marketing automation platform headquartered in Turkey. It empowers businesses to orchestrate personalized customer communications across email, SMS, WhatsApp, and push notification channels from a single unified platform.

## Overview

Pika is designed for marketing teams and enterprises that need to manage complex, multi-channel customer engagement at scale. The platform combines campaign management, customer journey automation, audience segmentation, content creation, analytics, and compliance tools into one integrated solution.

### Key Capabilities

- **Multi-Channel Campaigns**: Manage email, SMS, WhatsApp, and push notification campaigns from one dashboard
- **Marketing Automation**: Build automated customer journeys triggered by events, behaviors, and schedules
- **Audience Segmentation**: Create dynamic segments based on demographics, behavior, purchase history, and custom attributes
- **Personalization Engine**: Deliver individualized content, product recommendations, and offers
- **A/B & Multivariate Testing**: Optimize subject lines, content, send times, and channels
- **Real-Time Analytics**: Monitor campaign performance, engagement metrics, and conversion rates
- **Data Management**: Import, transform, and unify customer data from multiple sources via ETL pipelines
- **Compliance**: Built-in GDPR and KVKK (Turkish data protection law) consent management
- **Enterprise Security**: SOC-compliant infrastructure, data encryption, and role-based access control

### Technical Details

- **Website**: https://pika.tr
- **Application**: https://app.pika.tr
- **Supported Languages**: Turkish (tr), English (en)
- **Platform Type**: SaaS (Software as a Service)
- **Target Market**: Turkey and global markets

---

## Solutions - Detailed

### Campaign Manager
**URL**: https://pika.tr/en/solutions/campaign-manager

The Campaign Manager is the central hub for creating, scheduling, and managing marketing campaigns across all channels. It supports multi-step campaign workflows, audience targeting, scheduling with timezone optimization, and real-time performance monitoring.

### Audience Manager
**URL**: https://pika.tr/en/solutions/audience-manager

Advanced audience segmentation and management tool. Create dynamic and static segments using behavioral data, demographics, engagement history, and custom attributes. Supports real-time segment updates and audience size estimation.

### Journey Manager
**URL**: https://pika.tr/en/solutions/journey-manager

Visual customer journey builder for designing automated marketing workflows. Supports triggers (events, time-based, behavioral), conditional branching, wait steps, multi-channel touchpoints, and goal tracking. Enables lifecycle marketing from onboarding to re-engagement.

### Content Studio
**URL**: https://pika.tr/en/solutions/content-studio

Drag-and-drop content editor for designing responsive email templates, landing pages, and marketing content. Includes a template library, brand asset management, dynamic content blocks, and mobile preview.

### Email Marketing
**URL**: https://pika.tr/en/channels/email

Enterprise email marketing solution with high deliverability infrastructure. Features include bulk sending, transactional emails, dynamic personalization, send-time optimization, inbox preview, spam score checking, and dedicated IP management.

### SMS Campaigns
**URL**: https://pika.tr/en/channels/sms

SMS campaign management with support for promotional and transactional messages. Includes sender ID management, message scheduling, character count optimization, link shortening and tracking, and opt-out handling.

### WhatsApp Messaging
**URL**: https://pika.tr/en/channels/whatsapp

WhatsApp Business API integration for customer engagement. Supports template messages, interactive messages, media sharing, chatbot flows, and two-way conversations with customers.

### Analytics & Reporting
**URL**: https://pika.tr/en/solutions/analytics-reporting

Real-time campaign analytics and reporting dashboard. Track opens, clicks, conversions, revenue attribution, engagement trends, and channel performance. Includes custom report builder and scheduled report delivery.

### Consent Management
**URL**: https://pika.tr/en/solutions/consent-management

GDPR and KVKK compliant consent and preference management. Manage opt-in/opt-out preferences across channels, maintain audit trails, handle data subject requests, and ensure regulatory compliance.

### Integrations
**URL**: https://pika.tr/en/integrations

Connect Pika with third-party platforms including CRM systems, e-commerce platforms, analytics tools, and custom applications via REST APIs, webhooks, and pre-built connectors.

### Security & Privacy
**URL**: https://pika.tr/en/security-and-privacy

Enterprise-grade security infrastructure including data encryption at rest and in transit, role-based access control, IP whitelisting, SSO/SAML integration, and comprehensive audit logging.

### AI Campaign Assistant
**URL**: https://pika.tr/en/products/ai-campaign-assistant

AI-assisted campaign creation engine for drafting marketing campaigns, target audience recommendations, and email templates from natural language prompts.
